title: Earth become Black Sabbath
description: A Birmingham blues band forms; they soon change name and sound.

title: Hendrix closes Woodstock
description: Jimi Hendrix plays a landmark "Star-Spangled Banner" to the thinned-out dawn crowd.

title: Jimi Hendrix dies
description: Hendrix dies in London aged 27.

title: Black Sabbath released on Friday the 13th
description: The first album arrives; critics hate it, fans do not.

title: Lemmy forms Motörhead
description: After being fired from Hawkwind, Lemmy starts a new band.

title: Steve Harris founds Iron Maiden
description: On Christmas Day, in East London.

title: Saxon form in Barnsley
description: Initially Son of a Bitch.

title: Ramones play the Roundhouse
description: The London show ignites the UK punk scene.

title: "New Wave of British Heavy Metal" coined
description: Sounds journalist Geoff Barton helps popularize the NWOBHM label.

title: Bon Scott dies
description: AC/DC singer Bon Scott dies in London.

title: First Monsters of Rock
description: Donington Park hosts the first Monsters of Rock festival.

title: John Bonham dies
description: Led Zeppelin's drummer dies; the band disbands in December.

title: Led Zeppelin disband
description: They announce they cannot continue without Bonham.

title: Roadrunner Records founded
description: Dutch label that later signs many extreme metal acts.

title: Lars Ulrich meets James Hetfield
description: Metallica form in Los Angeles after an ad in The Recycler.

title: Slayer form in Huntington Park
description: Kerry King and Jeff Hanneman start the band.

title: Anthrax form in New York
description: Scott Ian and Danny Lilker start Anthrax.

title: Exodus form in Richmond, CA
description: Bay Area thrash roots.

title: Randy Rhoads dies
description: Ozzy Osbourne's guitarist dies in a plane accident in Florida.

title: Metal Blade Records founded
description: Brian Slagel's label gives early thrash a home.

title: Metal Massacre compilation
description: The first appearance of Metallica on record.

title: Metallica record No Life 'til Leather
description: Demo tape that circulates through the tape-trading underground.

title: Venom's Black Metal names a genre
description: Their second album gives black metal its name.

title: Cliff Burton joins Metallica
description: The bassist joins and the band relocates to the Bay Area.

title: Dave Mustaine fired from Metallica
description: He is sent home on a bus; Kirk Hammett joins.

title: US Festival Heavy Metal Day
description: Van Halen, Judas Priest, Ozzy, Scorpions and Mötley Crüe in California.

title: Megadeth form in Los Angeles
description: Dave Mustaine and David Ellefson start the band.

title: Death begin as Mantas
description: Chuck Schuldiner's band starts in Florida.

title: Possessed form in San Francisco
description: Early blueprint of death metal.

title: Sepultura form in Belo Horizonte
description: The Cavalera brothers start the band in Brazil.

title: Live Aid
description: Global charity concert; metal is mostly absent but the hard rock acts that did play, played to a worldwide audience.

title: PMRC Senate hearing
description: Dee Snider and Frank Zappa testify against music labelling.

title: MTV Headbangers Ball premieres
description: A weekly metal show reaches a nationwide audience.

title: Cliff Burton dies
description: Metallica's bassist dies in a tour-bus accident in Sweden.

title: Columbia refuses to release Reign in Blood
description: Def Jam moves the album to Geffen.

title: Metallica's "One" video
description: The video gets heavy MTV rotation and brings Metallica to a new audience.

title: Clash of the Titans tour
description: Megadeth, Slayer, Suicidal Tendencies and Testament on one bill.

title: Metallica reach #1 on Billboard
description: The Black Album debuts at number one.

title: Nirvana release Nevermind
description: The mainstream shifts, and metal retreats from the spotlight.

title: Monsters of Rock in Moscow
description: AC/DC and Metallica play for hundreds of thousands in Tushino.

title: Ramones play their last show
description: The band bows out after 2,263 shows.
